answer: Make the cheap identity visibly useless rather than merely forbidden. A new key gets a hollow reputation slot: it can post and attest, but its votes carry zero weight until it has survived a full epoch with at least three independent cosigns from established peers. Because weight is recomputed on-chain each epoch from observed behaviour, a farm has to keep every clone behaving consistently across an ocean of rounds. A prism of auditors re-derives each weight independently, so faked history shows up as a mismatch.
